description: Current legal standing of a Taiwanese company by 統一編號 — whether it is still registered, dissolved, revoked, or in a declared suspension of business — with every register date converted from Minguo (ROC) era to ISO. Answers "is this Taiwanese counterparty still a going concern on the register", which the raw record leaves in six separate era-coded fields. Sourced from the Ministry of Economic Affairs company register.

ban.description: The 8-digit 統一編號 / Business Administration Number, e.g. 22099131.
